instructions_to_main_agent: Build the complete application with React (.js files) using existing Tailwind and Lucide icons.
Implement the dark sidebar + light workspace aesthetic strictly. Sidebar must be dark slate (#0B1120) with active amber highlights. Main area must be clean white/slate-50 with crisp 1px borders.
Do NOT use pure Inter for headings; configure Plus Jakarta Sans and IBM Plex Sans via Google Fonts in index.html or index.css.
All monetary values MUST follow Brazilian Real standard (e.g., R$ 14.850,00) with comma decimal separators and dot thousand separators.

All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, search, filters, links, status selects, pagination, table actions) MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='global-search-input', data-testid='kpi-faturamento-card', data-testid='btn-novo-pedido').
Never use fully transparent backgrounds on dropdowns, modals, or sticky navigation bars.

Provide rich interactive mock datasets for Paulispan (Supermercados renomados, padarias gourmet, linhas de sobremesas como Pavês 1kg, Tortas Holandesas, Bolos de Festa, Frotas de caminhões refrigerados e Promotores de campo).

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.anti_ai_slop: Reject generic purple neon gradients. Embrace the warmth and business authority of deep executive slate (#0B1120) with warm confectionery amber (#D97706) accents.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.spacing_and_hierarchy: Ensure generous internal padding (p-5 or p-6 on cards, p-6 or p-8 on main containers). Avoid cramped layouts.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.chart_standards: Use Recharts with custom tooltips, formatted currency in tooltips, smooth curves, and legible typography.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing_ready: Guarantee 100% of functional flows have data-testid for automated verification.
